header.running_head: Rebuking and Advising Caution to those who Do Not Abstain from Worldly Luxuries and Who Indulge themselves

blocks.text: Hadhrat Umar (RA) Rebuked his Son Abdullaah (RA) when he sees Meat with him

Hadhrat Hasan (RA) reports that Hadhrat Umar (RA) once went to his son Abdullaah (RA)'s house at a time when he was eating some meat. "Why are you eating this meat?" Hadhrat Abdullaah (RA) replied, "I was craving for some." Hadhrat Umar (RA) rebuked him saying, "Will you always buy something merely because you crave for it? It is enough to classify a person as extravagant for him to eat whatever he craves for."[^2]
The Advice Hadhrat Umar (RA) gave to Hadhrat Yazeed bin Abu Sufyaan (RA)

Hadhrat Sa'eed bin Jubayr reports that the news reached Hadhrat Umar (RA) that Hadhrat Yazeed bin Abu Sufyaan (RA) ate various types of meats. Hadhrat Umar (RA) then said to his slave Yarfa, "Let me know when his evening meal is served to him." When the meal was served to Hadhrat Yazeed (RA), Yarfa duly informed Hadhrat Umar (RA). Hadhrat Umar (RA) went to Hadhrat Yazeed (RA), greeted with Salaam and sought permission to enter. He entered when permission was granted and Hadhrat Yazeed (RA) offered Hadhrat Umar (RA) his dinner. When Thareed and meat were served, Hadhrat Umar (RA) joined Hadhrat Yazeed (RA) in the meal. When roasted meat was served, Hadhrat Yazeed (RA) took some while Hadhrat Umar (RA) did not. Hadhrat Umar (RA) then exclaimed, "Allaah! Are you eating a meal after a meal, O Yazeed bin Abu Sufyaan? I swear by the Being Who controls the life of Umar! If you oppose the lifestyle of Rasulullaah ﷺ and the Sahabah (RA), you will certainly be led off their path (and not reach the highest echelons of Jannah)."[^3]
Hadhrat Umar (RA) Criticises the world Before the Sahabah (RA)

Hadhrat Hasan reports that Hadhrat Umar (RA) once passed by a rubbish dump and stopped there. When his companions felt disgusted (at the sight and stench), Hadhrat Umar (RA) said, "This is your world that you aspire for (or he said, "This is your world that you rely upon")."[^4]
The Letter Hadhrat Umar (RA) Wrote to Hadhrat Abu Dardaa (RA) when he Built a Tall Building
Hadhrat Salma bin Kulthoom reports that when Hadhrat Abu Dardaa (RA) built a tall building in Damascus, the news reached Hadhrat Umar (RA) in Madinah.
